basics.name: Raúl Estévez Gómez
basics.label: Junior Photonics Designer
basics.summary: Telecommunications engineer specialized in microelectronics, photonics, and RF systems, with hands-on experience in PIC design, semiconductor devices, and high-frequency electronics. Proven track record in research and industry, including design, simulation and testing of GaN-based transistors, photonic integrated circuits, and RF/optical measurement techniques.

work.name: Sparc Foundry
work.summary: Currently working on the design and development of III-V semiconductor transistors, specifically GaN-based devices for high-power RF amplifiers and power electronics. Involved in device simulation, design optimization, and experimental characterization.

work.name: QOPHI
work.summary: Designed, simulated, and assembled a Transimpedance Amplifier (TIA) using COTS components for photonic integrated circuit (PIC) characterization for my final year project. I kept learning about RF and optical measurements of PICs at chip and wafer level.

work.name: QOPHI
work.summary: During my intership at QOPHI Lab I designed and simulated wideband transmission lines on ceramicsubstrates for PIC measurements. Conducted DC and RF measurements on wavelength meter and CV-QKD PIC’s. Designed, simulated, and tested a high-speed TIA for PIC photodiode characterization, and participated in scientific outreach during an open day event.

work.name: rurAllure
work.summary: Promoted heritage sites along European pilgrimage routes by adding new routes to  the database, creating interactive data visualizations, and automating image metadata processing with Python. In my second summer, I documented the Camino de Santiago without Asphalt.

work.name: University of Vigo
work.summary: Contributed to a research-industry project, developing a synchronization app for simultaneous video  playback on smartphones and museum TVs. Implemented hardware-accelerated video playback and BLE synchronization on Raspberry Pi devices.

work.name: rurAllure
work.summary: Made active contributions promoting heritage sites along European pilgrimage routes. My responsibilities included: incorporating new routes and points of interest into the project database, visually representing survey results of pilgrims through interactive data visualizations, and automating image metadata processing with Python and Bash scripts

publications.name: A Dashboard to Enable New Opportunities for Rural Development by Overcoming the Dominant Segmentation of European Pilgrimage Routes
